tagline: Deep-set fixed downlight for a 55mm cut-out, with UGR 15 and 2-step MacAdam colour consistency.
description: A compact 4W or 7W fixed recessed downlight in aluminium with a PC dark cover. The deep-set source keeps glare low (UGR 15) while delivering high colour quality with CRI 95+ and less than 1% ripple. Electronic short-circuit, overload, over-temperature and no-load protection.
specification: Cut-out Ø55mm. Minimum installation depth 80mm. Input voltage AC 220–240V. Power factor 0.95. Colour tolerance 2-step MacAdam. Ripple <1%. Operating temperature −25° to +45°. L90B10 @ 50,000h. L80B10 @ 100,000h. 7-year warranty

tagline: Three-phase track luminaire for work areas, with near-invisible DARKLIGHT optics.
description: FUSION is designed for work areas on three-phase track, so the number and position of luminaires can change at any time. DARKLIGHT optics keep the light source practically invisible from any angle, reducing glare for a comfortable workspace.
specification: Dimensions 420 × 133 × 68mm. Thermo-lacquered aluminium body. PMMA lens with anti-glare reflector. Efficiency 125 lm/W. Colour stability 3 SDCM. L80B10 100,000h at Ta 25°C. Insulation class II. IK03. Weight 1.18kg. 230V AC 50Hz. Indoor use

tagline: A slim linear profile for continuous lines of light.
description: Arkeon 2.0 is a 62mm-wide aluminium profile for suspended or ceiling-mounted runs in offices, shops, showrooms and hospitality spaces. Choose direct or direct/indirect light, a collimated CLD diffuser for screen work, a satin diffuser or an asymmetric lens, at 20W or 40W per metre. Spot modules with 15° to 50° lenses add accent light in the same line.
specification: Linear profile for suspended or ceiling mounting (suspension and ceiling kits ordered separately). Lengths 1128 | 1408 | 1688 | 1968 | 2248 | 2808 | 3088mm, section 62 × 103mm. Direct or direct/indirect emission. CLD collimated diffuser UGR<16 | satin methacrylate diffuser UGR<22 | asymmetric PMMA lens UGR<22. Low power 20W/m | high power 40W/m. Spot module for the profile: PC lens 15° | 24° | 36° | 50°, UGR<19. Built-in driver, 230–240V 50–60Hz, PF>0.97 (DALI versions 220–240V 50–60Hz). CRI>90. MacAdam 3. L90/B10 >50,000h. Eye safety RG0/RG1. IP40. Aluminium with epoxy powder coating, White RAL 9003 or Black RAL 9005. End caps ordered separately (kit 46AA09). Order code: base code, then D for DALI, then B (white) or C8 (black). 5-year warranty.

tagline: An adjustable recessed downlight in five sizes and six styles.
description: Make is a compact recessed downlight for accent and general lighting, from a 50mm to a 150mm cut-out. It comes with a trim, frameless for plaster-in ceilings, as a twin, or with the light source set back in the Deep and Deep Pro versions for lower glare. Lenses run from 15° to 70°, and the reflector matches the housing colour.
specification: Recessed adjustable downlight; Deep Pro versions with a fixed, set-back light source. Sizes Micro | Mini | Small | Medium | Large for cut-outs from Ø50 to Ø150mm. Frameless (FL) versions for plaster-in installation; Double versions with two heads. Polycarbonate lens 15° | 24° | 36° | 50° (70° on Medium and Large). Reflector in the housing colour. UGR<19; Deep Pro UGR<16. 230–240V 50–60Hz, PF>0.97 (DALI versions 220–240V 50–60Hz). CRI>90. MacAdam 3. L90/B10 >50,000h. Eye safety RG0/RG1. IP44, IK02. Epoxy powder-coated aluminium, White RAL 9003 or Black RAL 9005 wrinkled. Order code: base code, then D for DALI, then W (white) or BK (black). 5-year warranty.

tagline: A swivelling downlight that tilts out of the ceiling.
description: Make R has a rotating body that can sit flush in the ceiling or be pulled out and tilted to aim the light, so displays and work areas are easy to refocus. Four sizes from Ø78 to Ø195mm, with 15° to 50° lenses and outputs up to 35W.
specification: Recessed swivelling and adjustable downlight; the body can be partly extracted and tilted or stay fully recessed. Sizes Mini | Small | Medium | Large for cut-outs Ø68 | Ø125 | Ø150 | Ø175mm. Polycarbonate lens 15° | 24° | 36° | 50° (Mini 24° | 36° | 50°), polycarbonate front reflector. UGR<19. 230–240V 50–60Hz, PF>0.97 (DALI versions 220–240V 50–60Hz). CRI>90. MacAdam 3. L90/B10 >50,000h. Eye safety RG0/RG1. IP44. Epoxy powder-coated aluminium, White RAL 9003 or Black RAL 9005 wrinkled. Order code: base code, then D for DALI, then W (white) or BK (black). 5-year warranty.
dimensions_note: Mini Ø78 × 56mm, cut-out Ø68 · Small Ø138 × 105mm, cut-out Ø125 · Medium Ø165 × 132mm, cut-out Ø150 · Large Ø195 × 152mm, cut-out Ø175

tagline: A versatile aluminium profile for continuous rows of light.
description: Groove is an extruded aluminium profile that can be recessed, surface mounted or suspended, and joined into long continuous rows. It comes with a DPL prismatic diffuser for UGR<19 or a satin PG diffuser for UGR<22, in low or high output, with direct or direct/indirect light. Adjustable spot modules fit the same profile to add accent lighting in shops and schools.
specification: Extruded aluminium profile 88 × 87mm, epoxy powder coated. Recessed, surface or suspended mounting, in continuous rows. DPL microprismatic diffuser UGR<19 | PG satin methacrylate diffuser UGR<22 | spot modules with 50° aluminium reflector. Direct | direct/indirect emission. Low power 20 W/m | high power 40 W/m. Built-in driver. 220–240V 50/60Hz, power factor >0.97. DALI dimmable version (code suffix D). CRI>90. MacAdam 3. L90/B10 >50,000h. Photobiological risk group RG0/RG1. IP40. End caps, joints, suspension and recessing kits ordered separately. 5-year warranty.
dimensions_note: Profile 88 × 87mm · low power 1130–3080mm long · high power 1130–1690mm long · spot modules 162 / 262 / 362mm

tagline: Groove, recessed flush into plasterboard and slatted ceilings.
description: Groove Display is the recessed version of Groove, made for quick and precise installation in plasterboard and slatted ceilings. Continuous rows of low or high output sit flush with the ceiling behind a DPL prismatic diffuser rated UGR<19, so it suits offices and screen-based work.
specification: Recessed extruded aluminium profile 104 × 103mm, epoxy powder coated. Cut-out 98mm × length (+4mm with end caps). For plasterboard and slatted ceilings, in continuous rows. DPL (Diamond Prism LED) diffuser UGR<19. Direct emission. Low power 20 W/m | high power 40 W/m. Built-in driver. 220–240V 50/60Hz, power factor >0.97. DALI dimmable version (code suffix D). CRI>90. MacAdam 3. L90/B10 >50,000h. Photobiological risk group RG0/RG1. IP40. End caps and joints ordered separately. 5-year warranty.
dimensions_note: Profile 104 × 103mm · cut-out 98mm × length · low power 1130–3090mm long · high power 1130–1690mm long

tagline: A slim suspended tube of light.
description: Pipe Line is a slim Ø28mm suspended tube that lights offices, shops and homes with very little visual weight. Choose one tube (Mono) or a pair (Duo) whose tubes slide and rotate, with a satin PG diffuser for soft, even light or a DK microcell optic for UGR<16 glare control at desks. The driver sits in a remote ceiling box, so the tube itself stays clean and minimal.
specification: Suspended Ø28mm aluminium tube, epoxy powder coated in a wrinkled finish. Mono: one tube. Duo: two tubes that slide and rotate 360°. PG satin methacrylate diffuser UGR<22 | DK high-contrast microcell optic UGR<16 | PG-DK combination. Direct emission. Remote driver in a ceiling box. 220–240V 50/60Hz, power factor >0.97. DALI dimmable version (code suffix D). CRI>90. MacAdam 3. L90/B10 >50,000h. Photobiological risk group RG0/RG1. IP40. 5-year warranty.
dimensions_note: Ø28mm tube · Mono 1448–2888mm long · Duo 1088 / 1448mm long, 139mm wide

tagline: One slim profile, many ways to light a space.
description: Twos is a slim 43mm profile system with one body and many optics: microcell, diffuser, lens, downlight and spot versions, with direct or direct/indirect light. Creative junctions join bodies at angles, Combo versions mix optics in a single body, and a 48V track module adds low-voltage spots to the line. It suits offices, shops and hospitality projects that need ambient and accent light from one consistent line.
specification: Extruded aluminium profile 43 × 63mm, epoxy powder coated. Suspended, or recessed with a bracket kit, in continuous rows; creative junctions join bodies at 2, 3 or 4 ways. DK microcell optic UGR<16 | CLD diffuser UGR<19 | PG satin diffuser UGR<22 | PMMA lens 60° | 110° | asymmetric | downlight and spot modules. Direct | direct/indirect emission; Combo versions mix optics in one body. 48V track module with built-in transformer for Esse-Ci low-voltage spots. Built-in driver. 220–240V 50/60Hz, power factor >0.97. DALI dimmable version (code suffix D). CRI>90. MacAdam 3. L90/B10 >50,000h. Photobiological risk group RG0/RG1. IP40. End caps, joints and suspension kits ordered separately. 5-year warranty.

tagline: Twos, recessed flush for a continuous line of light.
description: Twos Display is the recessed version of Twos, sitting flush with the ceiling as a discreet, continuous line. Microcell, CLD and satin diffuser modules can alternate along one run to give each area the visual comfort it needs, with an asymmetric wall-wash lens and spot modules for accents.
specification: Recessed extruded aluminium profile 43 × 57mm with 58mm flange, epoxy powder coated. Cut-out 50mm × length + 7mm. Continuous rows; modules can alternate along one line. DK microcell optic UGR<16 | CLD diffuser UGR<19 | PG satin diffuser UGR<22 | asymmetric PMMA wall-wash lens | spot modules with PMMA lenses 15° | 24° | 36° | 50°. Direct emission. Built-in driver. 220–240V 50/60Hz, power factor >0.97. DALI dimmable version (code suffix D). CRI>90. MacAdam 3. L90/B10 >50,000h. Photobiological risk group RG0/RG1. IP40. IK06. End caps ordered separately. 5-year warranty.

description: Hall Led Ceiling IP65 PC is a sealed surface-mounted cylinder for canopies, soffits, verandas and wet areas. A clear protective glass covers an internal PC lens, with beams from 15° to 70° and a cut-off above 30° to keep glare down. Four sizes from Ø60 to Ø150mm, 9W to 50W, cover everything from entrances to high covered ceilings.
specification: Surface-mounted downlight for indoor and covered outdoor use. Integrated driver. CoB LED. Clear protective glass with internal PC lens 15° | 24° | 36° | 50°, plus 70° on Medium and Large. Cut-off >30°. CRI>90. MacAdam 3. L90/B10 >50,000h. Photobiological risk group RG0/RG1. Die-cast aluminium, wrinkled powder coat. IP65. IK06. Ambient temperature -20°C to +45°C. 230–240V 50/60Hz, PF >0.97. DALI version (code D). Frosted glass with gasket available. CE and RETILAP. 5-year warranty.

tagline: A slim Ø50mm ceiling cylinder with UGR<19 optics.
description: Hall Led Ceiling Pro is a slender surface-mounted downlight, just Ø50mm across, in a 165mm or 245mm body. PC lenses from 15° to 50° with UGR<19 give precise, comfortable light for hotels, shops and homes, and coloured front rings, a honeycomb louvre and a suspension kit let you tailor the look.
specification: Surface-mounted downlight. Built-in driver. CoB LED. PC lens 15° | 24° | 36° | 50°. External ring included. UGR<19. CRI>90. MacAdam 3. L90/B10 >50,000h. Photobiological risk group RG0/RG1. Die-cast aluminium, wrinkled epoxy powder coat. IP44. 230–240V 50/60Hz, PF >0.97. DALI version (code D) on the 245mm body only. Front rings in chrome, gold, white or black (28RFA | 28RFG | 28RFW | 28RFBK). Honeycomb louvre (28AAND) and suspension kit with 3m cable (28AA165PS) available. CE. 5-year warranty.

tagline: A slim linear wall light for corridors, stairs and landings.
description: Arkeon Wall brings the narrow, clean profile of the Arkeon range onto the wall. Choose direct light through a satin diffuser with UGR<22, or a direct/indirect version that adds an asymmetric up-light to wash the ceiling. Four lengths from 288mm to 1978mm scale easily along corridors, stairwells and landings in offices, hotels, schools and healthcare.
specification: Wall-mounted linear luminaire. Built-in driver. Direct emission through a satin diffuser, UGR<22, or direct/indirect emission with an asymmetric PC lens for the up-light. CRI>90. MacAdam 3. L90/B10 >50,000h. Photobiological risk group RG0 (direct) | RG0/RG1 (direct/indirect). Aluminium body, epoxy powder coat. IP40. 230–240V 50/60Hz, PF >0.97. DALI version (code D) on the 1978mm length. Energy class C. CE. 5-year warranty.

tagline: A tiny 48V zoom spot for accent lighting on low-voltage track.
description: Teres LV Micro Zoom is the smallest Teres: a Ø31mm head for 48V low-voltage track with a zoom lens you can set anywhere from 10° to 40°. Choose a single head or a twin-head version on one adaptor. It suits display niches, artwork and retail accents where the fitting should all but disappear.
specification: Track spotlight for 48V low-voltage track. Built-in driver. 48V DC operation. Zoom lens 10°–40°. Single head (1X) or twin head (2X) on one adaptor, 90° tilt. CRI>90. MacAdam 3. L90/B10 >50,000h. Photobiological risk group RG0/RG1. Die-cast aluminium, epoxy powder coat. IP40. Energy class E. CE and RETILAP. 5-year warranty.

tagline: A compact 48V track spot with a 10°–60° zoom.
description: Teres LV Mini Zoom is a Ø50mm spot for 48V low-voltage track, with a zoom lens that runs from a tight 10° to a broad 60°. Its 8W and 12W versions give enough output for shop displays, galleries and hospitality, while the slim adaptor keeps the track line clean.
specification: Track spotlight for 48V low-voltage track. Built-in driver. 48V DC operation, 8W (350mA) | 12W (500mA). Zoom lens 10°–60°. Optional frosted or micro-engraved front glass. CRI>90. MacAdam 3. L90/B10 >50,000h. Photobiological risk group RG0/RG1. Die-cast aluminium, epoxy powder coat. IP40. Energy class E. CE and RETILAP. 5-year warranty.

tagline: The Teres Pro spot, built for 48V low-voltage track.
description: Teres Pro LV puts the Teres Pro head on 48V low-voltage track, with fixed PC lenses from 15° to 50° or a 10°–45° zoom. At 15W and 21W it gives over 2,000 lumens from a Ø50mm body, and UGR<19 keeps it comfortable for accent and general lighting in shops, galleries and hospitality.
specification: Track spotlight for 48V low-voltage track. Built-in driver. 48V DC operation, 15W (350mA) | 21W (500mA). PC lens 15° | 24° | 36° | 50°, or zoom lens 10°–45°. UGR<19. Honeycomb louvre available. CRI>90. MacAdam 3. L90/B10 >50,000h. Photobiological risk group RG0/RG1. Die-cast aluminium, epoxy powder coat. IP40. Energy class E. CE and RETILAP. 5-year warranty. DALI version (code D). Front ring for the PC version in chrome, gold, white or black (14RFA | 14RFG | 14RFW | 14RFBK).

tagline: A track spot with a double joint and a swappable cover.
description: Teres Ark is a cylindrical track spotlight with its driver hidden in the track adaptor. A double 90°+90° joint lets it aim almost anywhere, even straight up, and the housing cover can be swapped for a different finish. Mini (Ø70) and Small (Ø90) heads, with fixed lenses or a zoom lens.
specification: Track spotlight with in-track driver; adaptor 220mm long (260mm on DALI versions). Double 90°+90° joint. CoB LED. PMMA lenses: Mini 15° | 24° | 36° | 50°; Small 15° | 24° | 36° | 50° | 70°; Zoom Mini 20°–50°; Zoom Small 20°–60°. UGR<19. 230–240V 50–60Hz, PF>0.97 (DALI versions 220–240V 50–60Hz). CRI>90. MacAdam 3. L90/B10 >50,000h. Eye safety RG0/RG1. IP40, IK02. Epoxy powder-coated aluminium, White RAL 9003 or Black RAL 9005 wrinkled; interchangeable housing cover. Order code: base code, then D for DALI, then W (white) or BK (black). 5-year warranty.

tagline: 24V flexible LED strip with Nichia LEDs and 112 LEDs per metre, standard or slim.
description: FL112 Nichia 24V is a flexible LED strip with 112 high-quality Nichia LEDs per metre for coves, shelving, joinery and continuous lines of light. It comes on an 8mm board or a slim 5mm board for tight profiles, at CRI 90, CRI 95 or Optisolis full spectrum from 1800K to 6500K, with 3-step MacAdam colour consistency. A thick copper PCB with constant-current regulation keeps light output even along the run.
specification: Flexible LED strip, 112 LEDs/m, 24V DC, driver sold separately. Nichia LEDs, 3-step MacAdam. CRI>90 | CRI>95 | Nichia Optisolis. 1800K–6500K. Constant-current regulated copper PCB, reverse voltage protection. Thermally conductive adhesive tape. Width 8mm | 5mm (slim). Cut every 62.5mm. Dimmable. 120° beam. Operating temperature -25°C to +50°C. Supplied on 10m or 50m reels or cut to length. Power, flux and efficacy per metre.

tagline: 48V flexible LED strip with Nichia LEDs and 112 LEDs per metre, for long, even runs.
description: FL112 Nichia 48V is a flexible LED strip with 112 Nichia LEDs per metre on an 8mm board. The 48V supply allows much longer runs from a single feed, for coves, façade details and continuous lines of light. Choose CRI 90, CRI 95 or Optisolis full spectrum from 1800K to 6500K, with 3-step MacAdam colour consistency.
specification: Flexible LED strip, 112 LEDs/m, 48V DC, driver sold separately. Nichia LEDs, 3-step MacAdam. CRI>90 | CRI>95 | Nichia Optisolis. 1800K–6500K. Constant-current regulated copper PCB, reverse voltage protection. Thermally conductive adhesive tape. Width 8mm. Cut every 125mm. Dimmable. 120° beam. Operating temperature -25°C to +50°C. Supplied on 10m or 50m reels or cut to length. Power, flux and efficacy per metre.

tagline: A slim 600mm bollard with light to one side or all round.
description: Boulevard Mini is a slender round bollard, 110mm across and 600mm high, for paths, entries and garden edges. Choose 180° light to one side or 360° light all round, through a polycarbonate diffuser. The driver is built in, anchor bolts are supplied, and it comes on/off, 1-10V or DALI.
specification: Surface-mounted round bollard, Ø110 × 600mm. 180° | 360° light emission. Extruded copper-free aluminium body, phospho-chromatised and polyester powder coated. Polycarbonate diffuser. Moulded silicone gasket and stainless steel screws. Anchor bolts included. Built-in LED driver 220–240V 50/60Hz. CREE JK3030 mid-power LEDs. IP65. IK10. Class I.
finishes: White Aluminium RAL 9006 | Anthracite Grey RAL 7016 | Black RAL 9005

tagline: A round bollard in three heights, designed by Momo Design.
description: Boulevard is a die-cast round bollard by Momo Design, 170mm across and 220, 600 or 1000mm high. Each height comes with 180° light for edges and walls or 360° light for open paths and forecourts, under a solid cap. The driver is built in, anchor bolts are supplied, and it comes on/off, 1-10V or DALI.
specification: Surface-mounted round bollard, Ø170mm. Heights 220 | 600 | 1000mm. 180° | 360° light emission. Die-cast copper-free aluminium body, phospho-chromatised and polyester powder coated. Polycarbonate diffuser. Moulded silicone gasket and stainless steel screws. Anchor bolts included. Built-in electronic LED driver 220–240V 50/60Hz. CREE XH-G mid-power LEDs. IP65. IK10. Class I. Designed by Momo Design.
finishes: White Aluminium RAL 9006 | Anthracite Grey RAL 7016 | Black RAL 9005

tagline: A round bollard with one to four light windows.
description: Sector is a 150mm round bollard in 380, 650 and 1000mm heights. Its head has one to four light windows behind opal tempered glass, giving 90°, 180°, 270° or 360° of light, so you can light just the path side or the whole area around it. The driver is built in, a 1m cable is fitted, and a base plate is available.
specification: Surface-mounted round bollard, Ø150mm. Heights 380 | 650 | 1000mm. 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 light windows. Extruded copper-free aluminium body, phospho-chromatised and polyester powder coated. Opal tempered glass. Moulded silicone gasket and stainless steel screws. Built-in LED driver 220–240V 50/60Hz. CREE XHP70 LED. 1m power cable included. IP66. IK10. Class II. Base plate AC053 ordered separately.
finishes: White Aluminium RAL 9006 | Anthracite Grey RAL 7016 | Matt Black

tagline: A slender round or square bollard with 360° downward light.
description: Promenade is a tall, slim bollard in a round (Ø150mm) or square (140mm) section, 705 or 1005mm high. A COB LED behind a Fresnel diffuser sends light down and all around the base, up to 3100 lumens, which suits promenades, plazas and wide paths. It comes with an anchor flange and threaded bolts, on/off, 1-10V or DALI.
specification: Surface-mounted bollard, round Ø150mm | square 140 × 140mm. Heights 705 | 1005mm. 360° downward light. Extruded aluminium body and die-cast aluminium cover, phospho-chromatised and polyester powder coated. Polycarbonate Fresnel diffuser. Moulded silicone gasket and stainless steel screws. Anchor flange with threaded bolts included. Built-in electronic LED driver 220–240V 50/60Hz. CREE CXB 1520 COB LED. Power cable not included. M16 cable gland. IP66. IK10. Class II. Base plate AC053 ordered separately.
finishes: White Aluminium RAL 9006 | Anthracite Grey RAL 7016 | Black RAL 9005

tagline: A flat rectangular bollard that washes the ground on one side.
description: Scout is a slim rectangular bollard, 66mm deep, that washes the ground to one side with a low 180° beam through a frosted glass window. Scout Mini is 150mm wide and 700mm high; Scout Medium is 230mm wide and 750mm high. It suits paths, steps and building edges, with the driver built in.
specification: Surface-mounted rectangular bollard. Mini 150 × 66 × 700mm | Medium 230 × 66 × 750mm. 180° floor-washing light. Extruded copper-free aluminium body, phospho-chromatised and polyester powder coated. Frosted tempered glass diffuser. Moulded silicone gasket and stainless steel screws. Built-in LED driver 220–240V 50/60Hz. CREE XH-G mid-power LEDs. IP65. IK08. Class I.
finishes: White Aluminium RAL 9006 | Anthracite Grey RAL 7016 | Black RAL 9005

tagline: A compact projector head for a low pole.
description: Coiny Bollard is a compact, coin-shaped projector head that clamps to a slim pole to light planting, signs or facades from low level. It has an 18°, 36° or 60° beam from a single COB LED running direct from mains. The 500mm or 1000mm pole with base, a ground spike and a visor are ordered separately.
specification: Projector head for pole mounting, 156 × 115 × 30mm. Die-cast copper-free aluminium body, phospho-chromatised and polyester powder coated. Tempered safety glass. Moulded silicone gasket and stainless steel screws. LUMENS EDC 38C COB LED, direct mains 220–240V 50/60Hz. 1m power cable included. IP66. IK08. Class I. Pole with base AC112 500mm | AC113 1000mm, spike AC044 and visor AC111 ordered separately.
finishes: White Aluminium RAL 9006 | Anthracite Grey RAL 7016 | Black RAL 9005

tagline: A low round bollard with downward light, designed by Nava + Arosio.
description: Tron is a low, round bollard by Nava + Arosio, 190mm across and 174mm high, for lighting paths and terraces from close to the ground. A COB LED behind a tough polycarbonate diffuser sends light down to one side (180°) or all around (360°). The driver is built in, and it comes on/off, 1-10V or DALI.
specification: Surface-mounted low round bollard, Ø190 × 174mm. 180° | 360° downward light. Die-cast aluminium body, phospho-chromatised and polyester powder coated. Polycarbonate diffuser. Moulded silicone gasket and stainless steel screws. Built-in LED driver 220–240V 50/60Hz. CREE CXB 1520 COB LED. IP66. IK10. Class II. Designed by Nava + Arosio.
finishes: White Aluminium RAL 9006 | Anthracite Grey RAL 7016 | Black RAL 9005

tagline: An L-shaped bollard that lights the ground on one side.
description: Periscope is an L-shaped bollard, 180 × 140mm, in 300, 500 and 750mm heights. Its overhanging head sends asymmetric light down and to one side, which suits paths alongside walls, steps and garden beds. Each height comes in 7W or 14W, with the driver built in and a 0.5m cable fitted.
specification: Surface-mounted L-shaped bollard, 180 × 140mm. Heights 300 | 500 | 750mm. Asymmetric downward light to one side. Extruded aluminium body, phospho-chromatised and polyester powder coated. Tempered safety glass. Moulded silicone gasket and stainless steel screws. Built-in electronic LED driver 220–240V 50/60Hz. CREE XP-G2 LEDs. 0.5m neoprene power cable included. M16 cable gland. IP65. IK10. Class I.
finishes: White Aluminium RAL 9006 | Anthracite Grey RAL 7016 | Matt Black

tagline: A slim pole bollard with a flared 360° head, designed by Nava + Arosio.
description: Alder is a slim bollard by Nava + Arosio: a 70mm pole topped by a flared 203mm die-cast head that spreads light all around it. It comes in 400, 800 and 1000mm heights, all at 20W and up to 1650 lumens, with the driver built in and a 1.5m cable fitted. An anchorage unit is available.
specification: Surface-mounted pole bollard, head Ø203mm, pole Ø70mm. Heights 400 | 800 | 1000mm. 360° light. Die-cast aluminium head and extruded pole, phospho-chromatised and polyester powder coated. Tempered safety glass. Moulded silicone gasket and stainless steel screws. Built-in electronic LED driver 220–240V 50/60Hz. CREE XH-G LEDs. 1.5m power cable included. PG11 cable gland. IP66. IK09. Class II. Anchorage unit AC065 ordered separately. Designed by Nava + Arosio.
finishes: White Aluminium RAL 9006 | Anthracite Grey RAL 7016 | Black RAL 9005

tagline: A cube floodlight in four sizes, with COB or high-power optics.
description: Qubo is a compact cube-shaped floodlight for walls, façades and planting, from the 60mm Micro to the 170mm Maxi. Its U-bracket tilts the head from 40° down to 90° up, and each size comes with a single COB LED for soft, even beams or high-power LEDs for beams from a tight 4° to a wide 55°. Mini, Medium and Maxi have the driver built in; the Micro runs from a separate 24V DC driver.
specification: Wall/façade floodlight with U-shaped fixing bracket, tilt +90° | -40°. Square head: Micro 60 | Mini 100 | Medium 140 | Maxi 170mm. Die-cast copper-free aluminium base and head, phospho-chromatised and polyester powder coated. Tempered safety glass. Moulded silicone gaskets and stainless steel screws. COB: CREE CXB COB LED, 14° | 35° | 55°. HP: CREE XHP35 LEDs, 4° | 10° | 28° | 55°. Built-in LED driver (Mini, Medium, Maxi). Micro: remote 24V DC driver, ordered separately. 1m power cable. IP66. IK10. Honeycomb louvre (.HC) to order with the luminaire. Anti-glare visor, spike and tree strap ordered separately.
finishes: White Aluminium RAL 9006 | Anthracite Grey RAL 7016 | Black RAL 9005

tagline: A round die-cast floodlight in three sizes.
description: Flash is a round floodlight for façades, walls and trees, Ø140, Ø198 or Ø248mm across, in die-cast aluminium with tempered glass. Each size comes with high-power LEDs in 10°, 30° or 45° beams, or a single COB LED at 35° for more output. The driver is built in, and it comes on/off, 1-10V or DALI.
specification: Round wall/façade floodlight on a fixing bracket. Medium Ø140 × 242mm | Maxi Ø198 × 277mm | Mega Ø248 × 369mm. COB: CREE CXA | CXB COB LED, 35°. Built-in LED driver 220–240V 50/60Hz. 1m neoprene power cable, nickel-plated brass PG11 cable gland. IP65. IK09. Anti-glare visor ordered separately (Medium, Maxi).
finishes: White Aluminium RAL 9006 | Anthracite Grey RAL 7016 | Black RAL 9005
dimensions_note: Medium Ø140 × 242mm · Maxi Ø198 × 277mm · Mega Ø248 × 369mm

tagline: A flat floodlight that sits close to the wall.

specification: Flat wall/façade floodlight. Medium 247 × 180 × 38mm | Maxi 340 × 212 × 43mm. Die-cast copper-free aluminium body, phospho-chromatised and polyester powder coated. Tempered safety glass. Moulded silicone gasket and stainless steel screws. CREE XP-G3 high-power LEDs, 10° | 30° | 45°. Built-in LED driver 220–240V 50/60Hz. 1m neoprene power cable, PG9 cable gland.
